name: vscode-pike
description: Complete language support for Pike including IntelliSense, go-to-definition, find references, diagnostics, hover, signature help, code completion, semantic tokens, call hierarchy, and workspace symbols.

pike.analysis.defines.description: Preprocessor constants for conditional analysis (e.g. FOO, BAR=1).

pike.analysis.defineFiles.description: Files containing newline-separated preprocessor defines for analysis.

pike.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Pike language server

pike.diagnosticDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before running diagnostics after a document change

pike.formatOnChange.description: Re-indent the affected lines automatically when code is inserted, deleted, or moved. Disable this if the formatter is producing incorrect indentation.

pike.formatOnType.description: Automatically indent the new line when pressing Enter, or realign a closing brace when typing }. Disable this if the on-type indentation feels wrong.

pike.formatting.maxLineLength.description: Maximum formatted line length. Set to 0 to disable line wrapping.

pike.formatting.braceStyle.description: Brace placement style for blocks: keep opening brace on the same line or move it to a new line.

pike.formatting.spaceAroundOperators.description: Insert spaces around binary operators during formatting.

pike.formatting.blankLinesBetweenFunctio.description: Number of blank lines to keep between top-level function declarations.

pike.runnable.testPattern.description: Regex pattern used to detect runnable Pike test functions for code lenses

pike.runnable.interpreterPath.description: Optional override path for the Pike interpreter used by run/test code lens commands

pike.runnable.interpreterArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to Pike for run/test code lens commands

pike.runnable.showCodeLens.description: Enable runnable and test code lenses generated by Pike LSP

pike.editorContextMenu.showRun.description: Show Run Pike File in the editor context menu

pike.editorContextMenu.showTest.description: Show Run All Tests in File in the editor context menu

pike.editorContextMenu.showOrganizeImpor.description: Show Organize Imports in the editor context menu

pike.runnable.saveBeforeRun.description: Automatically save dirty files before running Pike code

pike.runnable.cwd.description: Working directory for run/test commands: workspaceFolder or file directory

pike.runnable.useConfiguredPaths.description: Apply pikeModulePath, pikeIncludePath, and pikeProgramPath to run environment

pike.runnable.clearOutputBeforeRun.description: Clear output channel before each run/test command

pike.runnable.revealOutput.description: When to reveal the output channel: always, on error, or never

pike.runnable.testArgs.description: Additional arguments passed only to test commands

pike.testExplorer.enable.description: Enable Pike tests in the VS Code Test Explorer

pike.testExplorer.showOutput.description: Show Pike test execution output in the Test Output panel

pike.organizeImports.removeUnused.description: Remove unused imports when organizing imports. When false, imports are only sorted.

pike.imports.mode.description: Import organization mode: none disables organize imports, basic uses the default LSP organize action, grouped groups imports by stdlib, third-party, and local origins.

pike.imports.localPrefix.description: Prefixes used to classify import/include paths as local when pike.imports.mode is grouped.

pike.maxNumberOfProblems.description: Maximum number of diagnostics to report per file

pike.inlayHints.enabled.description: Enable inlay hints for Pike code

pike.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter name hints in inlay hints

pike.inlineValues.enabled.description: Enable inline values in Pike code

pike.autoDetectPaths.description: Auto-detect Pike executable and paths on startup

pike.promptForMissingPike.description: Show prompt when Pike is not found

pike.server.autoRestart.description: Automatically restart server after unexpected stop

pike.formatOnChangeDelay.description: Debounce delay for format-on-change in milliseconds

scripts.build: bun run build:test && bun run build:extension
scripts.package: bun run build && bun run bundle-server && yes | vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license
scripts.vscode:prepublish: bun run build && bun run bundle-server
scripts.test:unit: bun run build:test && bun test dist/test/mockOutputChannel.test.js
scripts.test:features: bun run build:test && bash scripts/test-headless.sh --grep 'LSP Feature E2E'
